item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier over the region. The easterly airstream is expected to be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually over the weekend. It will be hot with a few showers over the coastal areas. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled with showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.
